notes.title: iZBOT 1.1 Update
notes.content:
iZBOT 1.1 Patch Notes

The robot labs have been working overtime to work out why our pint size hero has been jumping at the same height every time. Turns out some jerk in engineering maxed out the power setting on iZBOT boots. This has been rectified and the jerk has been fired. You can go about your business avoiding spikes now!

Features:

    New variable height jump
    Global Leaderboard – Best overall time (via Steam community)


Undocumented Features:

    Shift, Ctrl and Alt weren’t able to be re-mapped as keys
    Slime Ball’s balls weren’t disappearing when he was defeated
    Pixel trail was sometimes displaying on top of iZBOT
    Collapsing bricks doubled up on some levels
    Bedlor’s jetpack sound sometimes didn’t turn off 


A number of level tweaks and re-designs to smooth / increase the difficulty.
